verdict.rationale: A managed Redis-compatible key-value store is a fair question for a cloud application platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents Managed Postgres, volumes and Sprite disks, but nothing on a Redis-compatible store for caching or job queues. Running Redis yourself on a Fly Machine would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a Redis-compatible key-value store for low-latency caching and job queues
